title: Kirkpatrick's AARO denied the Herrera incident but he privately admitted it to the Senate Intelligence Committee

tellings.quote: And I know for a fact that Sean Kapatrick has admitted outside of the office of arrow directly to members of the Senate Intelligence Committee that it did in fact happen exactly as reported by Michael Herrera and with my additions.

plain: Sean Kirkpatrick was the first head of the Pentagon office set up to investigate unexplained sightings. While that office denied a sighting reported by a former serviceman named Michael Herrera, Kirkpatrick is said to have admitted in private, to members of the Senate Intelligence Committee, that it happened "exactly as reported by Michael Herrera." Jake Barber, a former military helicopter pilot who says he once carried a recovered UFO with his helicopter, tells Michels he knows this "for a fact" and adds that Kirkpatrick also confirmed Barber's own additions to the story. If true, the official denial and the private admission would contradict each other.
